subject: reasoning
question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9513e7c5287eea40fcaac544c99dff443dd68169cb8a4752dd2be1fa6bc546c4.png]
solution:
Taking dice figure (2) and (3) as 1 and 3 are common.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fce6f902b5d76b42179e788e97eef689f6bdcca9271cb83915bda2d38a086ebf.png] 

The remaining number in Dice position (2) is 5.

The remaining number in Dice position (4) is 6.

So, 5 and 6 are opposite number pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is "5".
